nodes.label: Sprint 0: Foundation
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate all trivial single-file bugs. 7 parallel tracks: config-logging, db-connection, dicom-server, storage, websocket, code-quality, lifecycle-exceptions. No schema changes.

nodes.label: Sprint 1: Schema Migration
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Database schema hardening. 8 sequential steps: Alembic migration 006, UNIQUE(username), FK indexes, PK on replica_files, UNIQUE on shared_files(hash), indexes on patients(name)/logs(created), nullable file_changes.by_user_id, pre-migration dedup script.

nodes.label: Sprint 2: Data Integrity
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Fix all data-loss and race-condition bugs. 5 parallel tracks: files-core, replica-sync, users-auth, patient-study-series, share-file-changes. Critical path: C01 ES atomicity.

nodes.label: Sprint 3: Auth & Security
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate all authentication and authorization vulnerabilities. 3 parallel tracks: auth-hardening, rate-limiting, schema-validation. Invokes security-fastapi sub-skill.

nodes.label: Sprint 4: Performance & Scalability
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Fix all OOM risks, blocking patterns, and scaling bottlenecks. 3 parallel tracks: pool-tuning, storage-streaming, sync-engine.

nodes.label: Sprint 5: Observability
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Make the system observable in production. 4 sequential steps: JSON logging formatter, request_id middleware, Prometheus metrics, component-level health check.

nodes.label: Sprint 6: Testing
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Eliminate flaky tests, add real integration test coverage. 4 parallel tracks: fix-flakes, integration-infra (conftest + test DB fixture), integration-tests (11 DB tables), load-tests (k6/locust).

nodes.label: Sprint 7: Redis Features
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Horizontally-scalable WebSocket state via Redis pub/sub. 4 sequential steps: add redis dep, RedisPubSub channel-per-file manager, replace module-level dict, keep in-memory local cache.

nodes.label: Sprint 8: Frontend Hardening
nodes.author: quantumrad
nodes.rationale: Secure the frontend and improve UX under production load. 5 parallel tracks: login (CAPTCHA/progressive delay), auth-storage (httpOnly cookies), sidebar (fix PAGINATION.limit), retry (useFetch), perf (progressive loading + code splitting).

nodes.label: Dependencies with yield and scope

nodes.label: Class dependencies anti-pattern

nodes.label: Rule: Avoid Barrel File Imports
nodes.rationale: Tree-shaking cannot optimize libraries marked external (not bundled), and bundling to enable tree-shaking slows builds; deep imports load only what is used (15-70% faster dev boot, 40% faster cold starts).

nodes.label: Rule: Conditional Module Loading
nodes.rationale: Dynamic import() with a typeof window guard loads large modules only when a feature activates and keeps them out of the SSR server bundle.

nodes.label: Rule: Preload Based on User Intent
nodes.rationale: Prefetching heavy bundles on hover/focus (or when a feature flag enables) reduces perceived latency.
nodes.norm_label: rule: preload based on user intent

nodes.label: Rule: Version and Minimize localStorage Data
nodes.rationale: getItem/setItem throw in incognito/private browsing, when quota is exceeded, or when storage is disabled; versioned keys enable schema evolution and minimize stored tokens/PII.
nodes.norm_label: rule: version and minimize localstorage data

nodes.label: Rule: Use Passive Event Listeners for Scrolling
nodes.rationale: Browsers wait for listeners to finish before scrolling to check whether preventDefault() is called; { passive: true } enables immediate scroll for listeners that never prevent default.
nodes.norm_label: rule: use passive event listeners for scrolling

nodes.label: Rule: Avoid Boolean Prop Proliferation
nodes.rationale: Each boolean prop doubles the state space (2^n complexity) and creates unmaintainable conditional logic; explicit variant components via composition are self-documenting.

nodes.label: Compound Components
nodes.rationale: Consumers compose exactly what they need; no hidden conditionals or prop drilling; subcomponents can be rearranged freely; state shared via context instead of props

nodes.label: Render Props
nodes.rationale: Appropriate when parent needs to provide data back to the consumer; awkward for static structure composition compared to children

nodes.label: Children-Based Composition
nodes.rationale: Children-based APIs are more readable, compose naturally, preserve native semantics and avoid callback-signature surface

nodes.label: React Context Providers
nodes.rationale: Provider boundary determines access, not visual nesting; state implementation decoupled from UI so same UI works with different state sources

nodes.label: useEffect Hook
nodes.rationale: Effects are escape hatches for synchronizing with external systems, not for React logic; a common source of bugs (missing deps, infinite loops, stale closures) and performance overhead

nodes.label: Derived State
nodes.rationale: If a value can be computed from current props/state, do not store it in state or update it in an effect - derive during render to avoid extra renders and state drift

nodes.label: SSR Hydration
nodes.rationale: SSR/CSR divergence on client-only values (localStorage, cookies, random IDs, dates) must be handled without breaking SSR, causing visible flicker, or noisy hydration warnings

nodes.label: Error Boundaries
nodes.rationale: A single top-level boundary brings down the whole app on any error; too many boundaries create partially broken UI - feature-level boundaries isolate failures while keeping the rest usable

nodes.label: SVG Rendering Performance
nodes.rationale: SVG elements lack hardware-accelerated CSS animation in many browsers; static SVG is expensive to recreate on every render; excessive coordinate precision bloats file size

nodes.label: React Memoization
nodes.rationale: New non-primitive instances created on every rerender fail strict equality in memo(), silently breaking memoization

nodes.label: Put Interaction Logic in Event Handlers Rule
nodes.norm_label: put interaction logic in event handlers rule

nodes.label: Avoid useMemo for Simple Expressions Rule
nodes.norm_label: avoid usememo for simple expressions rule

nodes.label: Use Transitions for Non-Urgent Updates Rule
nodes.norm_label: use transitions for non-urgent updates rule

nodes.label: Use useRef for Transient Values Rule
nodes.norm_label: use useref for transient values rule

nodes.label: Web Application Prometheus Alert Rules Template
nodes.norm_label: web application prometheus alert rules template

nodes.label: Domain-Driven Project Structure
nodes.rationale: Store all domain directories inside src folder, inspired by Netflix's Dispatch; import from other packages with explicit module names

nodes.label: Async Routes Rule
nodes.rationale: Never run blocking I/O in async routes - sync routes run in threadpool, async routes on the event loop; CPU-intensive work must go to another process due to the GIL

nodes.label: Pydantic Validation Patterns
nodes.rationale: Excessively use Pydantic for validation; a controllable global base model serializes datetimes to GMT strings

nodes.label: Dependency Caching
nodes.rationale: FastAPI caches a dependency's result within request scope - parse_jwt_data used 3 times is called only once per request

nodes.label: Hide Docs by Default
nodes.rationale: OpenAPI docs disabled outside local/staging environments unless the API is public

nodes.label: Async Test Client
nodes.rationale: Set up the async test client (httpx ASGITransport) from day 0

nodes.label: remove_emoji (Deslop)
nodes.rationale: AI-generated code often includes emojis - strip them with a unicode regex

nodes.label: Password Hashing (passlib + bcrypt)
nodes.rationale: Never store plaintext passwords - hash with bcrypt via passlib CryptContext

nodes.label: JWT Create/Verify (python-jose)
nodes.rationale: Issue short-lived access tokens and validate them on each request

nodes.label: API Key Auth via Header
nodes.rationale: Protect internal endpoints with an X-API-Key header check

nodes.label: CORS Configuration
nodes.rationale: Lock CORS down to known origins

nodes.label: Hide OpenAPI Docs by Default
nodes.rationale: Disable docs endpoints in production

nodes.label: Key Expiration (TTL)
nodes.rationale: Always set TTLs to avoid memory bloat

nodes.label: FastAPI Caching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Cache-then-fetch with setex TTL to reduce database load

nodes.label: FastAPI Session Management
nodes.rationale: HttpOnly cookie session IDs in Redis with sliding TTL expiration

nodes.label: Rate Limiting (Upstash Ratelimit)
nodes.rationale: FixedWindow/SlidingWindow/TokenBucket limiters keyed per client IP, with X-RateLimit headers; multi-tier limits per plan

nodes.label: QStash Signature Verification
nodes.rationale: Verify Upstash-Signature on webhook endpoints to authenticate QStash callers

nodes.label: AssertEqual Type Testing
nodes.rationale: Verify type behavior with AssertEqual conditional-type tests and ExpectError helpers

nodes.label: TypeScript Best Practices (unknown over any)
nodes.rationale: Use unknown over any, prefer interface for object shapes, use type for unions, avoid type assertions, use strict mode

nodes.label: useEffect Abuse Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Derived state and event logic in useEffect cause extra render cycles and sync bugs - compute during render or run in event handlers

nodes.label: React 19 Hook Mistakes
nodes.rationale: useFormStatus must live in a child of <form>; use() must not receive a promise created inline in render

nodes.label: State Mutation Detection
nodes.rationale: Direct mutation (.push(), arr[i]=x) keeps the same reference so React skips re-render

nodes.label: State Management Quick Guide
nodes.rationale: Server data -> TanStack Query, global UI state -> Zustand, derived state -> Jotai, component-local -> useState, form state -> useActionState

nodes.label: TanStack Query Anti-Pattern
nodes.rationale: Never copy server data into local state - the query is the source of truth

nodes.label: TypeScript Config Recommendations
nodes.rationale: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, noImplicitReturns, exactOptionalPropertyTypes - noUncheckedIndexedAccess catches arr[i] returning undefined

nodes.label: Derived State in useEffect
nodes.rationale: Deriving state from props in useEffect causes an extra render and sync bugs - compute during render instead

nodes.label: Stale Closures in useEffect
nodes.rationale: Effects capturing stale props/state - use refs or include deps correctly

nodes.label: Direct State Mutation
nodes.rationale: Mutating state objects in place breaks reference-based re-render detection

nodes.label: Misused Memoization
nodes.rationale: Memoize only hot paths - premature memoization adds overhead

nodes.label: any Type Usage
nodes.rationale: any silences the type system - prefer unknown with narrowing

nodes.label: React.FC Abuse
nodes.rationale: React.FC/FunctionComponent hides children types and complicates generics - annotate props directly

nodes.label: Array Index as Key
nodes.rationale: Index keys break reconciliation on reorder/filter - use stable IDs

nodes.label: God Components
nodes.rationale: Components doing too much - split into focused components

nodes.label: Prop Drilling
nodes.rationale: Passing props through many layers - use context for shared data

nodes.label: Copying Server State into Local State
nodes.rationale: Keeping a local copy of query data leads to stale UI - TanStack Query is the source of truth

nodes.rationale: Re-export barrels hurt tree-shaking and create circular imports - import directly

nodes.rationale: Data fetching rules prioritization for review

nodes.rationale: Must be used in a component inside the <form> - use it for pending states

nodes.rationale: Can suspend; must not receive a promise created inline during render

nodes.rationale: Client components need the use client directive; server components can't use hooks or event handlers

nodes.rationale: Rotate refresh tokens on reuse; block_token api in api/users.py:189 detects replay
